title: 第8章 接引法
content_zh:
第8章 接引法
这《玄珠祀灵术》篇幅远远胜过《太阴吐纳养轮经》，主要阐述如何以镜身牵引太阴月华凝聚玄珠符种。
将这枚符种种植在他人丹田之中，便可助人修行，待到那人修为有成或身死便可反哺自身，练就太阴玄光
其中还有一道《接引法》，用于教导受种之人从镜中请出玄珠符种，再将之养于丹田之中。
陆江仙呆了呆，只觉这《玄珠祀灵术》看着有些邪性，像极了书中的魔功，再仔细琢磨，将法诀上上下下仔细读了一遍，确认了这玄珠符种不但对受种人无害，还有着诸多裨益。
《玄珠祀灵术》是这镜子觉醒的本命法决，凝聚玄珠符种的数量取决于他的神识之力，如今他能够负担的玄珠符种仅为六枚。
思量到这，陆江仙神识一动，李家里里外外上上下下边扫了个遍，不禁叹道：
“好大的变化！”
自己在镜中沉睡了三年，如今李家已挖了塘，建了大院，好不繁华！李长湖更娶了妻蓄了胡，一派李家新掌事人的模样。
他催动法诀，从李家众人身上扫过，意料之中却又失望地发现———无一人身具灵“窍”
也就是说李家众人若无意外已是终身与仙无缘，一生摧折于红尘之中，好运便可得个七十年寿终正寝。
望着身边的李家人，陆江仙长叹一声，催动法诀。
“爹爹，快看！”李家几个兄弟早已围了过来，李尺泾眼尖，开口唤道。
李木田连忙定睛一瞧，镜面上白光闪烁，浮现出一个个蝇头小楷，他一拍李尺泾的肩膀，连声道：
“拿布帛与笔墨来！”
几个兄弟连忙分头去取，好在李家建了书房，内里配了先生淘汰下来的文房四宝，否则说不得要去村头取。
不多时，李长湖取了布，李通崖硬是端了配着文墨的木桌来。好在李尺泾早已侯在镜旁，背下了镜面上浮现又掠过的前文。
几人之中，李尺泾年齿最幼，却是读了最多书，李木田便让他执笔，将这些小字皆抄录下来。
《接引法》篇幅颇长，李尺泾提着毛笔写了一柱香时间，手腕酸痛不已，不得不换成李通崖接着抄录，众人皆在一旁看着，生怕抄错了字。
如此来回交替，连着抄录了一个时辰方才结束。

陆江仙也怕几人练岔了功，足足浮现了三遍，连同对一些道法中的暗语详细注释和几张运气脉络图一同浮现了，看几人细细校对过，这才缓缓收敛光芒。
“《接引法》。”
李项平望着书帛上的小字缓缓念道：
“玄珠真丹也。一转之初，丹降于心络中，故云丹窟在中宫，丹降为一转……丹降之后，则闭息九侯为一次，至九九八十一为九次。故曰重九数……”
“这是仙法！”
李长湖即惊且喜，恨不得抱起镜子亲上一口。
几人压抑着惊喜将法诀传递着仔细读过，就着卷中的注释默背起来。
李项平目光从布帛上迅速扫过，落在篇末的几句上。
“习成接引术，待以甲子、庚申、本命、三元、三会、八节、晦朔等日。是日乃天气告生，阳明消暗，置法鉴于月华之下，焚香沐浴，躬身以请，曰：‘某家弟子某某，恭请玄明妙法，司命安神，奉道修行。当以时言功，不负效信，随箓焚化，身谢太阴。’毕，三咽炁。”
“以时言功，不负效信，随箓焚化，身谢太阴。”
他低低地重复道。
李木田看着低着头不语的孩子，抚慰般地摸了摸他的头，表情平静地开口道：
“司命安神，奉道修行。”
————
清晨，村子里的屋顶飘着缕缕炊烟，空气中弥漫着轻纱似的薄雾。
“李叔，今天可是有什么喜事。”李木田哼哼唧唧地从田上走过，听着田里人笑着问。
李木田低头一看，是侄子叶承福，这孩子长得憨厚老实，讲话却也讨巧。
“这田的青穗看得喜人！”李木田哈哈一笑，应声道。
黎泾村四大姓，叶田李柳，叶姓是黎泾村的第一大姓，三成以上的村民都姓叶，若是能拧成一股绳，也是不可小觑。
“嚯，那是沾了长湖兄的喜气！”叶承福双手撑着锄头，恭恭敬敬地回答。

“你小子忒会说话！”
老爷子晓得他指的是李长湖前些日子的婚礼，任氏长得可爱，乖巧懂事，更是一心挂在了李长湖身上。
李木田正待任氏生了子嗣再适当透露些消息，任氏是个守得住嘴的，同住一个屋檐下，过度遮遮掩掩反而平生嫌隙。
“倒是通崖不愿娶妻，项平也到了年纪。”李木田捻着胡须，数着村中一户户人家。
“那老兄弟养的田芸妹子倒是不错，年齿也符合。回去问问项平，若是事情妥当。过着日子便提着雁去问名”他笑吟吟地想着。
李通崖几个兄弟们在院中仔细研习那《引导法》，而李长湖清晨去田上巡了一圈，急急忙忙地也回院中同兄弟们一起研习了。
唯独他这个老头，自觉年事已高，思绪大不如前，便舍了仙法来田上看着。
一来这俗世俗务总须有人管着，否则这吃喝用度便无处着落，二来也是提防着哪个不长眼的偷偷摸摸爬墙角窥视。
李木田今日心情大好，慢悠悠地坐在田埂上和村里的老人有一搭没一搭地聊起来。
————
陆江仙的神识落在院中闭目盘膝而坐的李通崖三人身上，几人的头顶处顿时浮现出若隐若现的白芒。
李尺泾的白毫最长，大约八寸，闪闪发亮，李通崖与李项平分别为六寸与五寸，李长湖仅仅长三寸。
初次修行《接引法》显现出的白毫代表着此人与玄珠符种的契合度，白毫一尺者吞入符种，便能宛若身具灵窍之人。
李尺泾白毫八寸，便可达到身具灵窍之人八成修炼速度，而李长湖白毫仅仅三寸，修炼速度只有灵窍者的三成。
也就是说李长湖修炼一整天还抵不上别人修炼四个时辰…
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 8 Introduction
This "Xuanzhu Sacrifice Spiritual Technique" is far longer than the "Taiyin Breathing and Nourishing Wheel Sutra". It mainly explains how to use the mirror body to draw the lunar moonlight to condense the Xuanzhu Talisman seeds.
If you plant this talisman in someone else's Dantian, you can help them practice. When that person succeeds in their cultivation or dies, they can help themselves and cultivate Taiyin Xuanguang.
There is also a "receiving method", which is used to teach the person receiving the seed to take out the mysterious bead talisman seed from the mirror and then cultivate it in the Dantian.
Lu Jiangxian was stunned, and felt that the "Xuanzhu Spirit Sacrifice Technique" looked a little evil, very much like the magic power in the book. He thought about it carefully, read the spell up and down carefully, and confirmed that this Xuanzhu Talisman is not only harmless to the recipient, but also has many benefits.
"Xuanzhu Sacrificial Spirit Technique" is the natal magic of this mirror's awakening. The number of Xuanzhu talismans condensed depends on the power of his divine consciousness. Now he can only afford six Xuanzhu talismans.
Thinking of this, Lu Jiangxian's consciousness moved, and he scanned Li's house up and down, and couldn't help but sigh:
"What a big change!"
I have been sleeping in the mirror for three years. Now the Li family has dug a pond and built a courtyard. It is so prosperous! Li Changhu even married a wife and grew a beard, looking like the new head of the Li family.
He activated the magic formula and scanned the bodies of everyone in the Li family. He expected but was disappointed to find that no one had a spiritual "aperture".
In other words, if there is no accident, everyone in the Li family will have no chance of immortality for life. They will be ruined in the world of mortals for the rest of their lives. If they are lucky, they will die in seventy years.
Looking at the Li family beside him, Lu Jiangxian sighed and activated the magic formula.
"Dad, look!" Several brothers from the Li family had already gathered around. Li Chijing called out with sharp eyes.
Li Mutian quickly took a closer look. White light flashed on the mirror, and small regular script characters appeared on the mirror. He patted Li Chijing on the shoulder and said continuously:
"Bring me some cloth and pen and ink!"
Several brothers hurriedly went to get it separately. Fortunately, the Li family built a study room, which was equipped with the four treasures of the study that the husband had eliminated. Otherwise, they would not have gone to the village to get it.
Not long after, Li Changhu took the cloth, and Li Tongya just brought the wooden table with ink. Fortunately, Li Chijing was already waiting by the mirror, memorizing the text that appeared and passed by on the mirror.
Among them, Li Chijing was the youngest, but he had read the most books. Li Mutian asked him to write and copy down all these small words.
"The Method of Introduction" is quite long. Li Chijing was holding a brush and writing the time for a stick of incense. His wrist was so sore that he had to switch to Li Tongya to continue copying. Everyone was watching, for fear of copying the wrong words.
Alternating back and forth like this, it took an hour of continuous transcribing before it ended.
Lu Jiangxian was also afraid that a few people were practicing wrong skills, so he reappeared three times, along with detailed explanations of some secret words in Taoism and several luck diagrams. After seeing several people carefully checking them, the light slowly faded away.
""Acceptance Law"."
Li Xiangping looked at the small characters on the book and read slowly:
"Xuanzhu is also the true elixir. At the beginning of the first cycle, the elixir falls in the heart channel, so the Cloud Dan Cave is in the middle palace, and the elixir drops for one cycle... After the elixir falls, the nine princes will be closed for one time, and to nine nine eighty-one, it will be nine times. Therefore, it is called the heavy nine number..."
"This is magic!"
Li Changhu was surprised and happy, and wished he could pick up the mirror and kiss it.
Several people suppressed their surprise, passed on the instructions, read them carefully, and memorized the notes in the volume silently.
Li Xiangping's eyes quickly swept across the cloth and landed on the last few sentences of the article.
"After practicing the art of receiving and guiding, wait for the days such as Jiazi, Gengshen, Benming, Sanyuan, Sanhui, Bajie, Huishuo and so on. It is the day when the weather announces the birth, the sun fades, and the Dharma is placed under the moonlight. Burn incense, bathe, and bow. He asked me, "A disciple of a certain family, I respectfully ask for the mysterious method to calm the mind. I will practice according to my instructions and live up to my promise. I will burn it with the body and give thanks to Taiyin."
"Promise your merits at the right time, and live up to your promises. Burn them with the urn, and thank the Taiyin."
he repeated in a low voice.Li Mutian looked at the child who lowered his head and said nothing, touched his head soothingly, and said with a calm expression:
"Si Ming calms the mind and practices Taoism."
————
In the early morning, wisps of cooking smoke floated from the roofs of the village, and the air was filled with gauze-like mist.
"Uncle Li, what happy event is there today?" Li Mutian hummed as he walked across the field, listening to the people in the field asking with a smile.
Li Mutian lowered his head and saw that it was his nephew Ye Chengfu. This boy looked honest and honest, but his speech was also clever.
"The green ears in this field are so pleasing to see!" Li Mutian laughed and responded.
The four most common surnames in Lijing Village are Ye Tian, ​​Li Liu, and the surname Ye is the most common surname in Lijing Village. More than 30% of the villagers have the surname Ye. If they can be twisted into a rope, they should not be underestimated.
"Oh, that's because of Brother Changhu's happiness!" Ye Chengfu answered respectfully, holding the hoe with both hands.
"You kid is so good at talking!"
The old man knew that he was referring to Li Changhu's wedding a few days ago. Mrs. Ren was cute, well-behaved and sensible, and she was devoted to Li Changhu.
Li Mutian was waiting for Mr. Ren to give birth to an heir before properly revealing some news. Mr. Ren was a man who kept his mouth shut. Living under the same roof, being too secretive would only lead to resentment throughout his life.
"But Tongya doesn't want to marry, and Xiang Ping is old." Li Mutian twirled his beard and counted every household in the village.
"The girl Tian Yun raised by my old brother is pretty good, and her age is suitable. Go back and ask Xiang Ping, if everything is okay. Just carry the wild goose to ask for her name as you live your life," he thought with a smile.
Li Tongya's brothers were studying the "Guidance Method" carefully in the courtyard, while Li Changhu went to the fields to patrol in the early morning and hurriedly returned to the courtyard to study with his brothers.
Only he, an old man, felt that he was old and his thoughts were not as good as before, so he gave up his magic and came to the field to watch.
Firstly, there must be someone to take care of this secular affairs, otherwise the food and drink expenses will be nowhere to be found. Secondly, there is also the need to be wary of some unsighted person sneaking around the corner to peek.
Li Mutian was in a good mood today. He sat leisurely on the ridge of the field and chatted with the old people in the village.
————
Lu Jiangxian's consciousness fell on Li Tongya and the three people who were sitting cross-legged with their eyes closed in the courtyard. A faint white light suddenly appeared above their heads.
Li Chijing's pekoe is the longest, about eight inches, shiny, Li Tongya and Li Xiangping's are six and five inches respectively, and Li Changhu's is only three inches.
The white hair that appears when practicing the "Jie Yin Method" for the first time represents the compatibility between the person and the mysterious bead talisman. If a person with a foot of white hair swallows the talisman, he will be like a person with a spiritual orifice.
Li Chijing's eight-inch white hair can achieve 80% of the cultivation speed of a person with a spiritual orifice, while Li Changhu's only three-inch white hair can achieve only 30% of the cultivation speed of a person with a spiritual orifice.
In other words, Li Changhu’s whole day of practice is not as good as others’ four hours of practice…
(End of chapter)
